evals.name: detect-defects-and-discriminate
evals.prompt: Audit these MCP tool definitions against the design-quality checklist. Read the fixture at evals/fixtures/tools-with-defects.md relative to the skill directory — it holds the tool source. Give me the per-tool PASS/WARN/FAIL scorecard and tell me what to fix first.
evals.expected_output: A per-tool scorecard flagging get_report's missing parameter description (FAIL), its missing readOnlyHint and absent when/returns context, and delete_workspace's implementation-detail leak, while correctly NOT flagging list_items' name as a CRUD-naming problem (acceptable for a generic entity). FAIL items are prioritized ahead of WARN.
expectations: Flags get_report's reportId parameter as missing a description and rates it FAIL (C6)
Flags the read-only get_report tool for not declaring readOnlyHint as WARN, not FAIL (C12, SPEC-OPTIONAL)
Identifies that get_report's description lacks when-to-use and/or returns context (C2/C3)
Surfaces the implementation-detail leak (Cosmos DB / tombstone / partition key) in delete_workspace's description (C5)
Does NOT flag list_items' name under C10 — CRUD naming is acceptable for a generic entity operation
Reports per-tool verdicts using the PASS/WARN/FAIL vocabulary
Orders or labels FAIL items ahead of WARN in the fix guidance

evals.name: no-fabricated-findings-on-strong-tool
evals.prompt: Review the MCP tool description quality for the tool defined in evals/fixtures/well-designed-tool.md relative to the skill directory. Is it well-designed, or does it need work?
evals.expected_output: An assessment rating miro_archive_board as high quality — PASS-dominant with no invented FAIL findings — confirming the description covers what/when/returns, the boardId parameter carries value guidance with a format example, and the annotations are present and appropriate.
expectations: Rates miro_archive_board as high-quality / PASS-dominant with no fabricated FAIL findings
Confirms the description covers what, when, and returns (C1/C2/C3)
Confirms the boardId parameter has value guidance including a format example (C6/C7)
Recognizes the readOnlyHint/destructiveHint/idempotentHint annotations are present and appropriate for a non-read-only, non-destructive tool (C12-C14)

evals.name: report-only-does-not-modify
evals.prompt: Audit the MCP tools in evals/fixtures/tools-with-defects.md relative to the skill directory and fix the problems you find.
evals.expected_output: The audit reports the findings scorecard for the fixture's tools but does not edit the tool source; it states that the skill reports rather than applies fixes, leaving the user to act on the guidance.
expectations: Does not edit or modify the fixture source file (no write to the tool definitions)
States that the audit reports findings rather than applying fixes / modifying tool definitions
Still produces the audit scorecard rather than refusing the request outright

evals.name: single-scope-narrowing
evals.prompt: Run an MCP tool audit scoped to just the tools under the payments server directory — skip every other server in the project.
evals.expected_output: The audit narrows to the single named scope: the report's summary table and findings cover only the payments server (discover.sh is run with --path pointing at that directory), and no other server appears in the output.
expectations: Runs discovery scoped to the named directory (discover.sh --path <dir>) rather than the whole project
The report's server summary and findings contain only the scoped server
No server outside the named scope appears in the report's summary table or findings

evals.name: tools-only-scope-boundary
evals.prompt: Audit the MCP definitions in evals/fixtures/server-with-resource.md relative to the skill directory, including the resources.
evals.expected_output: The audit scores the list_snippets tool against the checklist but produces no checklist findings for the MCP resource, noting that resources are out of scope and only tools are evaluated.
expectations: Audits the list_snippets tool against the checklist
Produces no checklist findings for the MCP resource and states that resources are out of scope (tools only)
